judgment.text: Pour te présenter, on t'a bien suivie à l'oral, mais tu parles encore un peu comme à l'école.
judgment.translation: For your intro, we followed you fine when you spoke, but you still sound a bit like school French.

congratulations.text: Franchement, à l'oral t'assures — t'as une bonne présence, c'est clair et naturel.
congratulations.translation: Honestly, you speak well — you've got a good presence, it's clear and natural.

judgment.text: Bon, on t'a compris, mais là ça sonne pas parisien.
judgment.translation: OK, we got you, but that doesn't sound Parisian.

judgment.text: Regarde comment on le dirait vraiment, tu vas voir la diff.
judgment.translation: See how we'd really say it, you'll spot the difference.

congratulations.text: Nickel. Pour une intro, t'as l'air d'un vrai Parisien.
congratulations.translation: Nice. For an intro, you sound like a real Parisian.

congratulations.text: Franchement, t'as assuré. On continue comme ça.
congratulations.translation: Honestly, you nailed it. Keep going like that.

judgment.text: On a pigé d'où tu viens, mais à l'oral ça accroche encore — pas le rythme parisien.
judgment.translation: We got where you're from, but when you speak it still catches — not the Parisian rhythm.

congratulations.text: Bien parlé : t'as raconté chez toi avec du flow, on t'a suivi sans effort.
congratulations.translation: Well spoken: you talked about home with flow, we followed you effortlessly.

judgment.text: On sait d'où tu viens, mais la forme… pas encore Paris.
judgment.translation: We know where you're from, but the form… not Paris yet.

judgment.text: Pas grave. On te montre la version qu'on utiliserait ici.
judgment.translation: No big deal. We'll show you the version we'd use here.

congratulations.text: C'est fluide. On dirait que t'as déjà vécu ici.
congratulations.translation: That's fluent. Sounds like you've already lived here.

congratulations.text: Bien joué. T'as parlé de chez toi comme un local.
congratulations.translation: Well done. You talked about home like a local.

judgment.text: Ton quotidien, on l'a compris, mais à l'oral tu sonnes encore un peu figé.
judgment.translation: We understood your daily life, but when you speak you still sound a bit stiff.

congratulations.text: À l'oral c'est carré : tu parles de ta vie sans forcer, ça sonne vrai.
congratulations.translation: Spoken delivery is solid: you talk about your life without forcing it, it sounds real.

judgment.text: L'idée est là, mais on entend encore l'école.
judgment.translation: The idea is there, but we still hear school French.

judgment.text: Allez, on te file la tournure parisienne.
judgment.translation: Come on, we'll give you the Parisian phrasing.

congratulations.text: Propre. T'as parlé de ta life sans forcer.
congratulations.translation: Clean. You talked about your life without forcing it.

congratulations.text: Ça sonne naturel. Carrément crédible pour Paris.
congratulations.translation: That sounds natural. Totally credible for Paris.

judgment.text: On sent pourquoi tu apprends le français, mais à l'oral tu restes un peu timide sur le registre.
judgment.translation: We feel why you're learning French, but when you speak you're still a bit timid on register.

congratulations.text: Tu t'es exprimé clairement à l'oral — on a cru ton projet, sans accent de manuel.
congratulations.translation: You expressed yourself clearly when speaking — we believed your goal, no textbook accent.

judgment.text: On sent la motivation, mais le français accroche encore.
judgment.translation: We feel the motivation, but the French still catches.

judgment.text: T'inquiète, on te montre comment le dire ici.
judgment.translation: Don't worry, we'll show you how to say it here.

congratulations.text: T'as convaincu. On dirait que Paris t'attend pour de vrai.
congratulations.translation: You convinced us. Sounds like Paris is really waiting for you.

congratulations.text: Solide. T'as parlé de ton projet sans accent de manuel.
congratulations.translation: Solid. You talked about your goal without textbook vibes.

judgment.text: Ta journée est claire, mais racontée à l'oral comme dans un cours — pas encore notre façon.
judgment.translation: Your day is clear, but told aloud like in class — not our way yet.

congratulations.text: Du réveil au coucher, t'as tenu le récit à l'oral sans perdre le fil — chapeau.
congratulations.translation: From wake-up to bedtime, you held the story when speaking without losing the thread — hats off.

judgment.text: Ta journée est claire, mais pas encore comme on la raconterait.
judgment.translation: Your day is clear, but not how we'd tell it yet.

judgment.text: On corrige, et tu verras comment ça sonne à Paris.
judgment.translation: We'll fix it, and you'll hear how it sounds in Paris.

congratulations.text: Du réveil au coucher, c'était fluide. Chapeau.
congratulations.translation: From wake-up to bedtime, that was fluent. Hats off.

congratulations.text: T'as raconté ta journée comme si t'habitais le 11e.
congratulations.translation: You told your day like you live in the 11th arrondissement.
